chapter: The Second Herd and its sidemen
title: Hearing Ernie Royal and starting the Second Herd
summary: He heard Ernie Royal in Phil Moore's group on Sunset Boulevard, decided to form a band, and Ralph Burns and Jimmy Giuffre helped.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Where and how did that come about? Live? Did you hear him live?
Yeah, I heard him in a little group down on Sunset Boulevard. Very talented guy, arranger, songwriter, material writer, pianist. Phil Moore --

-- had a little group, and Ernie and his brother Marshall, and I forget who he's the drummer in the rhythm section. But when I hired heard Ernie, and he was playing exclusively in a Harmon mute and a cup mute, when I heard him and what he could do with such ease, I decided to get me a band.
Now, how did you generate this new edition of the band?
Well, I just asked him if he wanted to come join, and he said, 'Yeah, that sounds all right.' So I said, 'Well, I'll put together a band then.' And I got some of the people back.
And Ralph came out to help me put it
together and then we got Jimmy Giuffre Duke who showed up to write a including, couple of things, and the Four Brothers, and we were on our way.
We went ahead and did some records right away.
